draft.subject: ML Engineer, Generative Video role at Mirage
draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I recently graduated with an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology, and I am reaching out about the ML Engineer, Generative Video role on your team.

The posting asks for deep learning systems and infrastructure experience with PyTorch and CUDA, and that is where most of my work has lived. I have written custom CUDA kernels to cut inference latency on convolutional models, applied quantization to shrink a language model's memory footprint with almost no accuracy loss, and built a real time perception pipeline that had to hit tight latency budgets end to end. My background comes from internships and independent research rather than a full time role, so the years on paper do not match exactly, but the systems and optimization work behind it is real.

I would love to send over my resume if that is useful.
